title: Arrian, Anabasis of Alexander (trans. E. J. Chinnock, 1884)

verification_log.method: 3.15: the battle of Arbela (Gaugamela) fought in the archonship of Aristophanes, month Pyanepsion; 3.21–22: Darius III wounded by his own officers and died before Alexander saw him, archonship of Aristophon, month Hecatombaion; Arrian's narrative does not mention Jerusalem (only the translator's note refers to Josephus)
